name: Professional Postponer
blurb: Certified expert in doing it later. Today you opened the app anyway.

name: Tab Hoarder
blurb: Forty tabs open, one of them is now actual work.

name: Reluctant Starter
blurb: You grumbled, and then you started. That counts double in spirit.

name: Two-Minute Tourist
blurb: You keep visiting work for two minutes. Work is starting to recognise you.

name: Accidental Worker
blurb: You sat down for two minutes and somehow stayed.

name: Daily Shower-Upper
blurb: You show up. Rain, mood or cricket match.

name: Deadline Dodger
blurb: Deadlines used to chase you. Now they have to book in advance.

name: Proof Collector
blurb: Your vault is getting heavy. Your excuses are getting light.

name: Habit Mechanic
blurb: You keep small routines running like a well-oiled scooter.

name: Early Finisher
blurb: Submitting before the last hour. Friends are suspicious.

name: Streak Engineer
blurb: You build days on top of days and they hold.

name: Momentum Machine
blurb: Starting is no longer an event. It is just what you do.
